$comment: Large golden fixtures are pulled, never committed, like the engine's (its fixtures/fixtures.json is the source of these entries). `make fixtures` (scripts/fetch_fixtures.py) fetches every entry below into fixtures/, verifying sha256 and size; the golden suite pulls when missing. `url` is relative to `baseUrl`; XMF_FIXTURES_URL overrides `baseUrl` (http(s): or file:), for a mirror of the fixtures/ prefix.
